blocks.md: This lesson follows **The Boundary Contract** in *Workload Placement* (Vol IV).

blocks.source: Vol IV, Workload Placement, § The Boundary Contract
blocks.md: Relocating the permission path isolates the execution domains on separate processors, but the two still have to talk. Consider an upstream proposal writer, such as the chunk policy on the application processor, that stalls or crashes halfway through publishing an action chunk. The downstream safety enforcer running on the real-time microcontroller still owes the physical plant a deterministic actuation decision on its very next tick.

questions.q: The section **The Boundary Contract** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: WCET comes from static analysis, measurement plus margin, hybrid methods, or probabilistic tail models, and local worst cases do not compose to a global one on modern microarchitectures.

On a shared die sustained inference drives the junction past the trip point, the governor cuts the clock so every tick overruns its bound, and hysteresis holds the clock down for seconds after the burst ends.
Execution budgets depend on the assurance level, so when a high-criticality task exhausts its lower budget the scheduler withdraws service from low-criticality work to keep the enforcer's tick.

The exchange has two separately timed obligations (board-link transport, then one bounded local publication read inside the WCET), and liveness needs a windowed watchdog that catches early feeds as well as late ones.
